## Reverse Computing

- The choice of what bond is an input or an output is completely left to the observer. Molecules do not inherently have inputs and outputs.

- Transpose operation.

- The resonance states must be bijective.

## Protobits

A "poor man’s quantum computer" refers to a probabilistic computer built using p-bits (probabilistic bits) instead of traditional bits or quantum qubits.

But conjugated carbon molecules are inherently quantum.
